Pins FORMAT §7.1 (D71 rule 3): w and m are calendar time, d is weekdays. Pre (5d) ends Fri 03-05.
Five (5d) starts Sat 03-06, which moves to Mon 03-08, and ends Fri 03-12 (Mon to Fri).
Week (1w, 7 calendar days) starts Sat 03-06 and ends Fri 03-12; w is not moved.
After week (3d) follows Week, so it would start Sat 03-13: it starts Mon 03-15 and ends Wed 03-17.
